# awx_team_object_roles (Data Source)

Lists the role IDs of an AWX team, keyed by role name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "awx_team_object_roles" "test" {
  id = awx_team.test.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Team ID

### Read-Only

- `roles` (Map of Number) Roles for team
